blocks.orig: Sand Rivers Selous is a light and airy lodge perched on a rocky outcrop overlooking the Rufiji River in Julius Nyerere National Park. The view across the swirling waters of the river is reminiscent of adventure movies, while the eight open-plan chalets on platforms give all the comfort and luxury one could wish for. Top-notch service caters to your every need, with dinner being served on an enormous tree converted into a dining table, and a swimming pool overlooking the mighty river. The interior of the rooms with its wooden structure, ecru fabrics, outdoor sitting area and outdoor shower enhances the feeling of having landed in paradise. After an exciting day full of (boat) safaris, there is nothing better than sitting on your porch and watching the sunset over the mighty Rufiji River at Sand Rivers Selous.
